title: Vanguard sergeant — rank markings
summary: A palette authored for one exact sculpt. It carries the same Painted Subject identity the rusted-armour workflow does, so both are discoverable from one identifier without any registry.
intent: Warm rank markings that read as the squad leader across the table.

target.description: Rank markings and power fist of the squad leader in a 28mm heavy infantry unit

identity.qualifier: sergeant variant — bare head and power fist; not an ordinary squad body

relationships.note: Read the power fist from the shaded plate outwards to the lit edge.
